name: smwgraphics-sunny-island
title: Sunny Island
description:
This is the fixed version of my first graphic. It's a simple BG of an island in the sea (which can be animated or not) with the Sun behind it. You can use it in sea-side levels or in a cutscene.
Uses BG1, ExAnimation and 2 rows of palettes ( the first half of the palette 0 and the palette 2).

This file contains:
-bg1.bin (the graphic itself);
-an2.bin (the ExAnimation);
-.mwl file (the sample level);
-Map16 file;
-.pal file (palette).

Credits? I would appreciate, but it doesn't need it.
